metadata.source: General emergency medicine and clinical triage literature compilation
metadata.clinical_review_status: NOT_REVIEWED - For educational, navigation, and demonstration purposes only.

warning_signs.name: Chest Pain Radiating to Left Arm, Jaw, or Back
warning_signs.description: Pressure, squeezing, fullness or pain in the center of the chest that radiates to shoulders, neck, jaw, or arms.
warning_signs.action_required: Call emergency medical services immediately (e.g. 911 / 112 / 999). Rest quietly while awaiting help.

warning_signs.name: Facial Droop, Arm Weakness, or Slurred Speech (FAST)
warning_signs.description: Sudden unilateral facial droop, inability to raise both arms equally, or slurred/incomprehensible speech.
warning_signs.action_required: Call emergency services immediately. Note exact time symptoms began (crucial for thrombolytic window).

warning_signs.name: Severe Respiratory Distress / Inability to Speak Full Sentences
warning_signs.description: Extreme shortness of breath with cyanosis (blue lips/fingers), intercostal retractions, or gasping.
warning_signs.action_required: Activate emergency response immediately. Maintain sitting upright position.

warning_signs.name: Anaphylaxis / Airway Compromise with Stridor or Tongue Swelling
warning_signs.description: Rapidly developing allergic reaction with tongue/throat swelling, hoarseness, stridor, or hypotension.
warning_signs.action_required: Administer intramuscular epinephrine auto-injector if prescribed and available. Call emergency services immediately.

warning_signs.name: Thunderclap Headache (Worst Headache of Life)
warning_signs.description: Headache reaching peak intensity in under one minute, often described as a catastrophic blow to the head.
warning_signs.action_required: Emergency Department evaluation immediately via emergency medical transport.

warning_signs.name: Uncontrolled Pulsatile or Severe External Hemorrhage
warning_signs.description: Active bleeding from a major blood vessel that does not stop with direct sustained pressure.
warning_signs.action_required: Apply firm direct continuous pressure; use commercial tourniquet if extremity and trained. Call emergency services.

warning_signs.name: Prolonged Seizure (>5 minutes) or Status Epilepticus
warning_signs.description: Continuous generalized seizure activity lasting more than 5 minutes or repeated seizures without regaining consciousness.
warning_signs.action_required: Protect patient from physical injury; do not put anything in mouth; position on side; call emergency services immediately.

warning_signs.name: Sudden Collapse or Loss of Consciousness During Exertion
warning_signs.description: Fainting or sudden cardiac arrest occurring during physical exertion or exercise.
warning_signs.action_required: Check responsiveness and breathing; begin CPR and use AED if pulseless; call emergency services immediately.

warning_signs.name: Signs of Systemic Shock (Cold Clammy Skin, Marked Confusion, Tachycardia)
warning_signs.description: Profound circulatory collapse: systolic blood pressure very low, extreme pallor, rapid thready pulse, oliguria.
warning_signs.action_required: Call emergency services immediately. Keep patient warm and supine with legs slightly elevated if tolerated.

warning_signs.name: Board-like Rigid Abdomen with Involuntary Guarding
warning_signs.description: Severe abdominal pain accompanied by generalized rigidity of abdominal muscles that cannot be voluntarily relaxed.
warning_signs.action_required: Emergency surgical evaluation required. Patient should not consume food or water.

warning_signs.name: Sudden Painless or Painful Loss of Vision in One or Both Eyes
warning_signs.description: Sudden complete darkness, curtain falling across vision field, or loss of central vision.
warning_signs.action_required: Immediate emergency ophthalmology evaluation within hours to prevent irreversible vision loss.

warning_signs.name: Vomiting Bright Red Blood or Dark 'Coffee-Ground' Material
warning_signs.description: Vomiting frank red blood or partially digested blood resembling dark coffee grounds in volume.
warning_signs.action_required: Emergency Department evaluation immediately via emergency medical transport.

warning_signs.name: Coughing Up Moderate to Large Volumes of Blood (>100 mL)
warning_signs.description: Coughing up fresh blood from the respiratory tract indicating pulmonary vascular breach.
warning_signs.action_required: Immediate emergency evaluation; position on affected side if known to prevent aspiration.

warning_signs.name: Acute Suicidal Ideation with Intent or Immediate Plan
warning_signs.description: Expressed thoughts of immediate self-harm with identified means or active suicidal gesture.
warning_signs.action_required: Do not leave patient alone. Call emergency services or national suicide prevention lifeline (988 in US / local crisis line).

warning_signs.name: High Fever with Inability to Touch Chin to Chest (Nuchal Rigidity)
warning_signs.description: Severe neck stiffness preventing neck flexion, accompanied by high fever and altered mental state.
warning_signs.action_required: Emergency room assessment immediately for urgent diagnostic lumbar puncture and antibiotics.

warning_signs.name: Rapidly Spreading Non-Blanching Purple Rash (Petechiae / Purpura)
warning_signs.description: Purple or red spots that do not fade or turn white when pressed firmly with a clear glass tumbler.
warning_signs.action_required: Immediate emergency hospitalization.

warning_signs.name: Complete Inability to Pass Urine with Painful Palpable Bladder
warning_signs.description: Distressing lower abdominal pain with complete cessation of urination over 8-12 hours.
warning_signs.action_required: Prompt emergency or urgent care decompression with Foley catheterization.

warning_signs.name: Sudden Severe Unilateral Testicular Pain with Swelling
warning_signs.description: Acute onset of high-intensity scrotal pain, swelling, and elevation of testis.
warning_signs.action_required: Immediate surgical evaluation within 6 hours to preserve testicular viability.

warning_signs.name: Severe Lower Pelvic Pain with Vaginal Bleeding and Positive Pregnancy
warning_signs.description: Unilateral pelvic pain, dizziness, or shoulder-tip pain in a female of reproductive age.
warning_signs.action_required: Immediate emergency evaluation for life-threatening hemoperitoneum.

warning_signs.name: Severe Hypoglycemia with Inability to Cooperate or Seizure
warning_signs.description: Severe low blood glucose in diabetic patient unresponsive to oral carbohydrates or unable to swallow.
warning_signs.action_required: Administer intramuscular glucagon if trained; call emergency services.

warning_signs.name: Unilateral Swollen Painful Calf Following Prolonged Inactivity or Surgery
warning_signs.description: Marked swelling, erythema, and warmth in one leg, especially with recent immobilization.
warning_signs.action_required: Same-day urgent medical evaluation with venous duplex ultrasonography.

warning_signs.name: Fever >= 38.0°C (100.4°F) in Infant Under 3 Months of Age
warning_signs.description: Any documented fever in a neonate or young infant, who have immature immune responses.
warning_signs.action_required: Immediate pediatric emergency evaluation; do not wait.

warning_signs.name: Simultaneous Headache, Nausea, and Confusion in Multiple Household Members
warning_signs.description: Shared symptoms occurring in an enclosed space with fuel-burning heaters or generators.
warning_signs.action_required: Evacuate the structure immediately into fresh air and contact emergency services.

warning_signs.name: Body Temperature > 40°C (104°F) with Hot Dry Skin and Delirium
warning_signs.description: Thermoregulatory failure following heat exposure; altered sensorium, lack of sweating.
warning_signs.action_required: Call emergency services; initiate rapid aggressive active cooling with cold water / ice immersion.

warning_signs.name: Severe Shivering Followed by Apathy, Slurred Speech, and Paradoxical Undressing
warning_signs.description: Core body temperature dropping critically low with cessation of shivering and confusion.
warning_signs.action_required: Gentle handling, passive and active rewarming, emergency transport.

warning_signs.name: Acid or Alkali Chemical Splash Directly into Eye
warning_signs.description: Contact with caustic cleaning products, battery fluid, or cement.
warning_signs.action_required: Immediately irrigate eye continuously with clean tap water or saline for at least 15-30 minutes; call emergency services.

warning_signs.name: Second or Third Degree Burns Covering >10% Body Area or Involving Face/Hands
warning_signs.description: Extensive blistering, charred, or leathery white tissue damage.
warning_signs.action_required: Cover with clean dry non-adherent dressing; keep warm; transport to burn center via EMS.

warning_signs.name: Deformed Limb with Bone Fragment Piercing Through Skin
warning_signs.description: High-energy extremity injury with open dermal wound communicating with fracture.
warning_signs.action_required: Cover with sterile dressing, immobilize without manipulation, emergency department transfer.

warning_signs.name: Head Injury with Loss of Consciousness, Brief Awakening, then Rapid Deterioration
warning_signs.description: The classic 'lucid interval' indicative of rapid intracranial arterial accumulation.
warning_signs.action_required: Immediate neurosurgical emergency evaluation.

warning_signs.name: Pain Out of Proportion to Injury with Tense Swelling and Paresthesia
warning_signs.description: Intense pain on passive muscle stretching, firm fascial compartment.
warning_signs.action_required: Emergency fasciotomy consultation required within hours.

warning_signs.name: Back Pain with Saddle Anesthesia (Numb Groin) and Fecal/Urinary Incontinence
warning_signs.description: Compression of cauda equina nerve roots causing perineal sensory loss and sphincter dysfunction.
warning_signs.action_required: Emergency MRI and decompression within 24-48 hours to prevent permanent deficit.

warning_signs.name: Yellow Skin/Eyes (Jaundice) with Spiking High Fever and Right Upper Quadrant Pain
warning_signs.description: Charcot's triad indicating acute purulent infection of the biliary tree.
warning_signs.action_required: Immediate hospitalization for resuscitation and urgent biliary decompression.

warning_signs.name: Blood Pressure > 180/120 mmHg Accompanied by Headache, Chest Pain, or Dyspnea
warning_signs.description: Extremely elevated blood pressure with evidence of acute end-organ damage.
warning_signs.action_required: Emergency room treatment with intravenous antihypertensive medications.

warning_signs.name: Severe Eye Pain, Colored Halos Around Lights, and Hazy Cornea
warning_signs.description: Rapid spike in intraocular pressure causing globe tenderness, nausea, and visual distortion.
warning_signs.action_required: Emergency ophthalmic pressure-reducing drops and systemic medications.

warning_signs.name: Deep Rapid Breathing (Kussmaul), Fruity Acetone Breath, and Vomiting in Diabetic
warning_signs.description: Metabolic acidosis resulting from severe insulin deficiency.
warning_signs.action_required: Emergency hospital admission for intravenous insulin and electrolyte replacement.

warning_signs.name: Sudden Sharp Pleuritic Chest Pain with Tracheal Deviation and Cyanosis
warning_signs.description: Air trapped under pressure in pleural cavity causing mediastinal shift and vascular collapse.
warning_signs.action_required: Immediate emergency needle decompression followed by tube thoracostomy.

warning_signs.name: Infection Signs with Tachypnea, Altered Consciousness, and Low Blood Pressure
warning_signs.description: Dysregulated host response to infection causing life-threatening organ dysfunction (qSOFA >= 2).
warning_signs.action_required: Immediate medical emergency: blood cultures, broad-spectrum antibiotics, and IV crystalloids.

warning_signs.name: Jet-Black, Tarry, Foul-Smelling Stools
warning_signs.description: Oxidized hemoglobin from significant upper gastrointestinal tract bleeding.
warning_signs.action_required: Urgent same-day medical assessment or emergency visit if accompanied by dizziness.

warning_signs.name: Sudden Choking with Inability to Speak, Cough, or Breathe
warning_signs.description: Complete mechanical obstruction of upper airway by food or foreign object.
warning_signs.action_required: Immediate Heimlich maneuver (abdominal thrusts) or back blows / chest thrusts; call emergency services.

warning_signs.name: Red, Swollen Skin Lesion Expanding Visibly Within Hours with Crepitus
warning_signs.description: Disproportionate soft tissue pain, bullae, skin anesthesia, or crackling gas sensation.
warning_signs.action_required: Surgical emergency consultation for immediate debridement and parenteral antibiotics.
